description.value: COBS Bread is a Canadian franchise arm of the Australian Bakers Delight chain, with 190 locations across Canada. Everything is baked from scratch on-site daily, and any unsold goods are donated to local charities at closing time. A touring cyclist stopping here can pick up fresh bread, rolls, bagels, scones, and savory baked items including mini pizzas and croissant-based pastries.
